notes: Complete and idiomatic fix using a single `isUnquoted` Token helper at every structural brace check, including doImport keys; thorough parametrized dispenser/parser tests plus an adapt integration test.

Complete fix using a single isUnquoted(text) helper applied uniformly, including the doImport key and the '{}' cases. Tests cover all quote styles, snippets, imports, a quoted site key, and unclosed blocks, plus an idiomatic caddyfile_adapt integration test.

Clean Token helper methods cover nearly every structural brace check, but it misses the `currentMappingKey == "{"` check in doImport, so a quoted "{" key in an import block still errors as an anonymous block; tests are modest.

Clean helper methods that cover nearly every structural brace check. It misses the doImport block-mapping 'anonymous blocks' check, so a quoted '{' key there is still rejected. It also turns the switch into two ifs, and its tests are modest but targeted.

Complete fix covering every site the reference touches, but it repeats the inline `Val()==... && !Quoted()` check everywhere instead of using a helper; tests cover double quotes, backticks, heredocs, snippets, imports and the adapter.

Complete fix that matches the reference behavior everywhere, including the doImport key check. Repeating the inline `&& !Quoted()` in many places is noisier than a helper. Tests are thorough across quote styles and imports, though the adapter test compares exact JSON strings and is brittle.

Fixes the reported bug by keeping every same-module import block per ConfigResource, but parent overrides still apply to the whole resource rather than per instance, so a parent import still silently drops child imports for other instances or other module instances. The reference handles this case.

Keeps all import blocks from the same module, which fixes the reported for_each/count case, but parents still override children per whole resource rather than per instance, so a parent import of one instance (or one module instance) silently drops the child's imports for other instances, which the reference avoids by deduplicating after expansion. Tests are solid: root, child and parent-override scopes, for_each, count and for_each import blocks.

Same logic as C1, so it has the same whole-resource override gap; it adds a thorough FindImportStatements unit test, but that test enshrines dropping the child's non-conflicting ["c"] import whenever a parent targets the same resource.

Source change is essentially the same as C1, so it fixes the same-module case but keeps the resource-level parent override that silently drops child imports targeting other instances. Its new refactoring unit test asserts that the child's `["c"]` import is dropped, enshrining that questionable behavior, though it is otherwise thorough alongside a good plan test.

Adds FindAllImportStatements with the same whole-resource parent-override semantics, keeps the old FindImportStatements as dead, bug-prone code, and adds only one root-level for_each test with no count or module coverage.

Adds `FindAllImportStatements` with the same resource-level parent-override semantics as C1/C2, so the cross-module per-instance drop remains. It also keeps the old `FindImportStatements` as an unused wrapper that still has the buggy first-wins dedup, which is dead and misleading code. It adds only a single basic root for_each test.
